line: LANE-ODDS-SHIP 2026-07-30: re-fit + re-measure of efv_odds_calibration on the current tree, against BOTH the incumbent and a flat base rate.
recalibrates: p_bust ONLY; the four non-bust buckets rescale proportionally so the 5-vector still sums to 1. No star map is fitted: the frame carries 9 hitter stars and 2 pitcher stars.

frame.pool: xfv_{hitter,pitcher}_matrix.json minus (kind=bust AND bust_recent), prepped on target_censored (efv_score.run's own pool + target)
frame.test_restriction: censored is False AND target_resolved numeric
frame.applied_population: rows with a milb block (the production guard `provisional=not src.get('milb')`), which on today's matrices is 906/907 hit and 920/920 pit the same rows as rates_missing == 0

arms.CAL: INC through a forward-chained per-side Platt map fit on out-of-fold rows of decision years < fold, within the cut's own population
arms.CONST: flat constant at the cut's own prior-fold base rate
arms.CONST_all: flat constant at the fold's FULL resolved-training base rate (the basis gate's arm C)

sign_convention: d = metric(baseline) - metric(CAL); POSITIVE means the recalibration is better.
ship_criterion: CAL beats BOTH the incumbent AND the within-cut flat base rate on Brier AND logloss, paired refit bootstrap CI95 excluding zero, on `pooled` AND `pooled_served`, and both observed deltas outside their permutation null bands.
caveats: Fold 2014 carries no prior out-of-fold rows, so CAL falls back to INC and CONST falls back to CONST_all there: a tie by construction that costs the candidate.

Per-fold Platt maps make CAL a globally non-monotone transform of INC, so CAL's AUC is not guaranteed to equal INC's here. The SHIPPED map is one global monotone transform per side and preserves every ranking exactly; that is verified separately at the wiring seam.

post_hoc_sensitivity_fitted_folds_only.what: The same gate restricted to folds where the forward chain actually had enough prior rows to FIT a Platt map. The early folds fall back to the incumbent, which production never does (it carries one map fitted on all history), so this asks whether the NULL is an artifact of that fallback.
post_hoc_sensitivity_fitted_folds_only.status: POST-HOC. Not part of the pre-registered criterion and it does not change the verdict.
post_hoc_sensitivity_fitted_folds_only.answer: It is not an artifact. On the `pooled` cut the recalibration now DOES beat the constant with the CI excluding zero (Brier +0.0213 CI [+0.0117,+0.0310], log loss +0.0681 CI [+0.0371,+0.0987]). On `pooled_served`, the population the production guard would actually apply the map to, it still does NOT (Brier +0.0195 CI [-0.0058,+0.0437] P=0.943, log loss +0.0351 CI [-0.0491,+0.0961] P=0.861). The applied population fails the constant test on the friendliest frame available.
